name: How should I choose the right contractor for a whole house renovation?

mainEntity.name: How should I choose the right contractor for a whole house renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When evaluating contractors for an extensive remodel, look for a proven track record in comprehensive interior renovations, verified licensing and insurance, and strong trade management practices. A key decision factor is whether you will communicate with a single point of contact who remains directly on-site to oversee custom framing, drywall, tile installation, and finish carpentry. Ask how the builder schedules and monitors licensed specialty sub-trades, such as plumbing and electrical. A contractor with hands-on oversight helps ensure quality control during critical structural phases and prevents miscommunication between different installation crews.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a licensed, insured contractor who provides a dedicated on-site contact, coordinates licensed sub-trades, and has proven finish craftsmanship.
